# Handysolver

> Handysolver is a Gurugram, India company that helps businesses replace disconnected tools, manual processes and repetitive tasks with connected software and practical automation. It offers business transformation, custom software and automation with applied AI.

Handysolver works hands-on with clients: listening to the problem first, agreeing a plan, building in the open and improving after launch. Contact is by WhatsApp, email or the contact form.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://handysolver.com/): what Handysolver does, case studies, client testimonials, how the work runs, and a two-minute workflow check
- [Meet the team](https://handysolver.com/team): the people at Handysolver
- [Careers](https://handysolver.com/careers): life at Handysolver and why people work here
- [Open roles](https://handysolver.com/careers/open-roles): current vacancies with role details and an application form
- [Photo gallery](https://handysolver.com/gallery): team moments, celebrations and outings
- [Let's talk](https://handysolver.com/lets-talk): contact form, WhatsApp, email and office address
